facts.fact: The official demonstrator explicitly runs Windows10 and Ubuntu on an x86 industrial PC using Intel virtualization, VirtIO communication and PikeOS queuing ports. Ubuntu can reboot without affecting Windows. The demonstrator includes native/additional partitions and USB-to-network processing.

facts.boundary: That description does not freeze all backing allocations, byte/node limits, actual source/build/provider rights or full transitive license approval.

full_independent_review.assessment: Public contracts support partition isolation, central control and predefined recovery, plus an affirmative Windows/Linux demonstration. They do not establish one independently reserved, nonblocking, allocation-free operation with a supported finite completion bound covering every execution/device/provider writer, pending queue, reference, finalizer, mapping and all physical backing. This missing positive contract prevents EQ083 selection on these pages; it is not a claim such a capability cannot exist in the product or another configuration.
